Bet Hatalmud

Campus-Chabad-House · Roma, Italy

Chabad educational department

Previous review (2026-10-06): Department listed by headquarters. Street also houses Oratorio Di Castro; current department operation at this address needs confirmation. Research 2026-10-13: The department has its own Chabad directory entry, ID 224356, at Cesare Balbo 33. The 5786 Rome community calendar lists Chabad Lubavitch teaching under Rav Itzchak Hazan at Balbo 33 (printed p. 17) and the Jewish Community Center at the same address (p. 23), both with postal code 00184. Locator uses 00186, so the community postal code is preferred. Review co-located records rather than assuming a separate building.
